'''31''' is a Korean animator who has contributed to the [[Pokémon]] series. Following a lengthy time as a fan artist on the series, he revealed himself as part of the Key Animation staff for ''[[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]''.<ref name=PTTP>[https://archive.is/urVVv 31 confirming he was an animator on Path to the Peak]</ref>
